name: UserPreferencesMask
comment: HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Control Panel\Desktop\UserPreferencesMask is an 8 byte little-endian REG_BINARY value that collects the per-user interface preferences win32k reads through SystemParametersInfo. Bits 32 and above are the ones the documentation calls "in the high dword". Bits marked untested have no confirmed Windows UI toggle; their meaning comes from win32k pseudocode or from SPI_ naming.

fields.name: Active window tracking
fields.meaning: Activates a window when the pointer moves over it, without a click. Untested.

fields.name: Menu animation
fields.meaning: Fade or slide menus into view. Performance Options.

fields.name: Combo box animation
fields.meaning: Slide open combo boxes. Performance Options.

fields.name: List box smooth scrolling
fields.meaning: Smooth-scroll list boxes. Performance Options.

fields.name: Gradient captions
fields.meaning: Each window title bar changes from one color or shade to another along its length. Untested.

fields.name: Keyboard cues
fields.meaning: Show menu underlines and other keyboard cues. Untested.

fields.name: Active window tracking Z-order
fields.meaning: Raise the window that active window tracking activates to the top of the Z-order. Untested.

fields.name: Hot tracking
fields.meaning: Highlight items as the pointer moves over them. Untested.

fields.name: Menu fade
fields.meaning: Fade menus instead of sliding them. Requires bit 1. Untested.

fields.name: Selection fade
fields.meaning: Fade out menu items after clicking. Performance Options.

fields.name: Tooltip animation
fields.meaning: Fade or slide ToolTips into view. Performance Options.

fields.name: Tooltip fade
fields.meaning: Fade ToolTips instead of sliding them. Requires bit 11. Untested.

fields.name: Cursor shadow
fields.meaning: Show shadows under the mouse pointer. Performance Options.

fields.name: Mouse sonar
fields.meaning: Show the location of the pointer when the CTRL key is pressed. Mouse Properties.

fields.name: ClickLock
fields.meaning: Turn on ClickLock, which holds the mouse button down after a brief press. Mouse Properties.

fields.name: Hide pointer while typing
fields.meaning: Hide the mouse pointer while typing. Mouse Properties.

fields.name: Flat menus
fields.meaning: Draw menus with the flat appearance instead of the raised one. Untested.

fields.name: Window shadows
fields.meaning: Show shadows under windows. Performance Options.

fields.name: UI effects master switch
fields.meaning: When enabled, all user interface effects are enabled: combo box animation, cursor shadow, gradient captions, hot tracking, list box smooth scrolling, menu animation, menu underlines, selection fade and tool tip animation. Untested.

fields.name: Client area animation
fields.meaning: Animate controls and elements inside windows. Stored as 0x00000002 in the high dword.

fields.name: Keyboard input delegation updates
fields.meaning: Suppress or apply global input-settings updates when focus or input delegation changes. Stored as 0x00000080 in the high dword. Untested.

fields.name: Pen button yield
fields.meaning: Pen button yield and pen quick-launch hotkey behaviour. Stored as 0x00000200 in the high dword. Untested.
